authority_rule.promotion: Authority may change only through an explicit promotion event with its own preserved evidence and receipt.

family_card.may: define visual descendants, roles, traits, and variant families

zora_evm_map.may: map creator surfaces, contracts, implementations, metadata, transactions, and relationships
zora_evm_map.may_not: promote any mapped node from reference to identity without a separate evidence receipt

constitutional_invariants: SHARED CONTRACT IS NOT SHARED CHARACTER.

evidence_boundary.absence_rule: Absence of evidence is not converted into evidence of absence.

evm_reference_rule.promotion: Any promotion beyond reference status requires separate explicit evidence and a new receipt.

observation_separation_rule.rule: Shared reference does not authorize merge. Each observation remains independently preservable until evidence explicitly proves equivalence.

rejected_lineage.rule: Rejected material is preserved as evidence of drift. It is never silently deleted and never promoted into the species root.

replay_state_rule: New evidence does not overwrite prior state. New evidence triggers another replay.

species_root.trait_rule: Shared species traits may vary by artifact; all canonical descendants remain visibly within the Gray Baby alien family.
